en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a neo‑Gothic style church with a tall tower and spire rising above surrounding villas and gardens, with hilly vineyards or terraces in the background. The lower margin bears the caption "Oberlößnitz-Radebeul." in red script, and there is a small red handwritten number "1345" in the upper right corner. Along the left edge appears a vertical printer's credit and number.
